ops.summary:
Get knowledge types matching the filter criteria. These knowledge types are as created by Knowledge Store Solutions. 
In case a tenant fetches the knowledge types, only those from the subscribed solutions will be returned.
Gets the knowledge type definition as created by an FSO Solution

Creates a new knowledge object based on the JSON schema in the type definition. The Knowledge Store will generate a knowledge object ID based on the content.
If a knowledge object with that ID already exists, the FSO Knowledge Store API will return conflict error. Otherwise, a knowledge object will be created.
This FSO Knowledge Store API takes LayerType and LayerId as an input allowing callers to specify the layer on which the knowledge object will be inserted.
More details about layer are covered in the TypeDefinition.
Get knowledge objects of a given type
Get knowledge object with specific ID.

Apply patch to a knowledge object. Intention of this FSO Knowledge Store API is to patch the target object which could be on the layer
above or even higher (see the layering feature of Knowledge Store mentioned in ObjectLayerType type of this spec).
Target knowledge object's ID is same as the Object ID passed in the parameter. Patch will be stored as a separate
object. And will be resolved when the object is being fetched. This allows the target object to be
updated independently, while still implementing the runtime layering feature of the Knowledge Store. Due to the
patch data, it is possible that id generated for the patch using idGenerationMechanism might be different
from the target knowledge object's ID. In that case, FSO Knowledge Store API will return HTTP code of 303 (Response code for See Other),
with the Location as the URL based on new object ID.
Update a knowledge object with complete object data.
Delete a Knolwedge Object that was already created.
